06-api.note: Interfaces, one file per part of the project: CORTHEX-MEMORY in memory.md (confirmed on 2026-10-27, checked together with the functional spec and the memory store), with its JSON Schemas and their examples beside it; NEXUS in nexus.md, with the NEXUS server's requests in the OpenAPI 3.1 contract nexus.openapi.yaml (drafted on 2026-11-02 while the memory plugin is built, as the maintainer chose that day; its API IDs start at API-101, and it passed its checkpoint on 2026-11-03 together with the NEXUS user flows, functional spec, server data, sitemap and screen states, so its requests, commands and formats are frozen for NEXUS 0.2). The memory plugin has no HTTP API, so its interfaces are not OpenAPI in Swagger UI, the stage's default: they are hooks, a background process, the memory skill's commands and calls to the model APIs and Git. The NEXUS server has one, so its contract is OpenAPI, kept beside the other interfaces instead of in api/openapi.yaml, and read in an OpenAPI viewer such as Swagger UI; the hub's commands are in nexus.md, in memory.md's form. Translations beside them are not read as sources. Korean copies, with the tables as databases, go in the project's Notion records and follow these files. MEMORY spec confirmed on 2026-10-27: D1, D2 and D4 as recommended; D3 uses a user-operated HTTPS sync gateway and Postgres/pgvector, with device-local files and SQLite; default raw retention 100 days. Git sync design status: superseded (D3, 2026-10-27); server sync design is required before C3.

07-sitemap.note: Sitemap of NEXUS only: the memory plugin has no screens, so this stage has no file for it. NEXUS's screens are in nexus.yaml, in the form of the stage 07 template with the terms that NEXUS's cross-check reads and a status for each, and nexus.md explains them (drafted on 2026-11-03 while the memory plugin is built, as the maintainer chose on 2026-11-02; its SCR IDs start at SCR-101, and it passed its checkpoint on 2026-11-03 together with the NEXUS user flows, functional spec, server data, interfaces and screen states). Not the stage's default page of three views: nexus.md holds the board and the list, drawn from nexus.yaml, and people read them in a Korean copy in the project's Notion records, with the list as a database; there are no slides, since one person checks the sitemap, and from NEXUS 0.2 NEXUS draws it itself. Translations beside them are not read as sources.

08-screen-states.note: Screen states of NEXUS only: the memory plugin has no screens, so this stage has no file for it. NEXUS's screen definitions are in nexus/, one file for each of the sitemap's screens, SCR-101 to SCR-109, named by its ID and a short name, with README.md for the rules of every screen and the final words of the messages (drafted on 2026-11-03 while the memory plugin is built, as the maintainer chose on 2026-11-02; it passed its checkpoint on 2026-11-03 together with the NEXUS user flows, functional spec, server data, interfaces and sitemap). The human view is the stage's default, grayscale wireframes drawn from the definitions: one page, nexus/wireframes.html, with a frame for each state at 320 and 1440 pixels, drawn again in the same change as the definitions, and looked at as a private published page whose link is in the project's records, not in `link`, since the repository is public. The definitions are read in a Korean copy in the project's Notion records, with the tables as databases. Translations beside them are not read as sources.

09-mockup.note: Mockups of NEXUS only: the memory plugin has no screens, so this stage has no file for it. NEXUS's design tokens are in design/nexus/, in the Design Tokens Community Group format 2025.10: base.tokens.json, one file for each theme under theme/, and tokens.resolver.json, which chooses between them (drafted on 2026-11-03 while the memory plugin is built, as the maintainer chose on 2026-11-02, on the recommendations of stages 03 to 08, whose joint checkpoint passed on 2026-11-03). Not Figma or Claude Design, the stage's defaults: Figma is not connected to this project, and a page drawn from the tokens keeps a token name in every value and can be measured in a browser. The maintainer chose direction A, Hub pages, on 2026-11-03, the stage's first checkpoint. Its mockups of every state of SCR-101, SCR-104 and SCR-105 to SCR-109 are one page, docs/09-mockup/nexus/mockup.html, explained in docs/09-mockup/nexus/README.md, and looked at as a private published page whose link is in the project's records, not in `link`, since the repository is public. The maintainer passed its second checkpoint, frozen tokens, on 2026-11-03, together with stages 03 to 08, so the tokens are frozen for NEXUS 0.2 before development uses them: a later change needs the maintainer's decision. Translations beside them are not read as sources.
